project_name: Connectify Club - Action Arcade 'Star Patrol' Replacement & Streamlined Atelier Experience
archetype: ORGANIC & PASTEL ATELIER WITH RETRO SPACE ARCADE (Tactile, warm cream canvas #fffaf5, high-contrast ink borders #172337, retro arcade neon accents)

action_arcade_specifications.replacement_for: Fruit Merge (Game Fruit Merge dihapus dan diganti penuh oleh Star Patrol)

core_mechanics.control_scheme: Touch / Drag movement with smooth lerp, automatic firing lasers
core_mechanics.gameplay_loop: Navigate spaceship through enemy waves, dodge asteroid & laser hazards, defeat stage bosses, collect Permen currency drops and temporary powerups
powerups: Triple Shot (Tembakan Tiga) - Fires 3 laser streams
Magnet Permen - Attracts all dropped candies/Permen on screen
Overdrive Laser - High speed rapid piercing lasers
core_mechanics.economy: Uses existing Permen currency for purchasing permanent ship upgrades, cosmetics, and item powerups in the simplified Shop.

profile_photo_fix.issue: Bug saat mengganti foto profil (tidak bisa disimpan / avatar selection failing)
profile_photo_fix.solution: Fix EditAvatarScreen state synchronization with ProfileContext and LocalStorage / Supabase state. Ensure selected avatar image path or ID updates immediately upon tap and persists across app reloads without falling back to default avatar.

profile_screen.style: Simplified, clean card layout with clear stats (Level, XP, High Score, Permen balance)
profile_screen.navigation: Direct 1-tap avatar photo change trigger opens EditAvatarScreen modal
profile_screen.features: Clear progress bar for XP/level progression, active cosmetics badge, direct access to collections

shop_screen.style: Simple categorized shop with top horizontal tab navigation: [Upgrades, Cosmetics, Themes, Chests]
shop_screen.navigation: Easy category switching with zero lag, clear Permen cost badges, instant purchase confirmation feedback via Sonner toast
shop_screen.cards: Compact cards with 2px ink borders (#172337), high contrast price tags, 'Milik' (Owned) vs 'Beli' (Buy) state badges

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-[#172337]
hierarchy.caption: text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium tracking-wide uppercase

colors.contrast_ratio_min: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for headers and buttons

visual_enhancers.card_style: 2px solid #172337 ink border, 3px offset box-shadow (shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#172337]), rounded-2xl bg-white
visual_enhancers.button_primary: bg-[#ffb9cd] hover:bg-[#ffa0bb] text-[#172337] font-bold border-2 border-[#172337] shadow-[3px_3px_0px_#172337] active:translate-x-[2px] active:translate-y-[2px] active:shadow-none transition-all rounded-xl min-h-[44px]
visual_enhancers.arcade_hud: High-contrast tactical arcade HUD overlay with health bar, shield timer, current score, and Permen counter

grids_and_layouts.mobile_container: max-w-[480px] mx-auto px-4 pb-24 pt-4 min-h-screen relative

motion.framework: Framer Motion for smooth screen transitions, bullet physics, and laser impact visual feedback

accessibility.testing_attribute: MUST add data-testid attribute in kebab-case format to every interactive element (e.g. data-testid='start-star-patrol-btn', data-testid='save-profile-avatar-btn', data-testid='shop-upgrade-laser-btn')
accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA & WCAG AA contrast standards against pastel cards and dark arcade gameplay backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace Fruit Merge completely with 'Star Patrol' auto-firing action arcade shooter mode with touch movement, wave progression, boss fights, item drops, and permanent upgrades.
Fix profile avatar update bug in EditAvatarScreen & ProfileScreen so selected avatar saves persistently to profile state.
Simplify ProfileScreen layout: keep it clean with level/XP progress, stats summary, avatar change button, and active equipment.
Simplify ShopScreen layout: organize items with clear tabbed navigation [Upgrades, Cosmetics, Themes, Chests] and straightforward 1-tap Permen buy buttons.
Ensure persistent state for XP, Level, Stats, Permen balance, and Missions.
Preserve all existing bitmap assets in /public/art/ without removing any file.
Perform game level & flow testing at the end after all implementations are complete.
Add kebab-case data-testid to every interactive component across the app.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attribute: MUST add data-testid to every interactive component (e.g. data-testid='shop-category-tab-upgrades')
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Avoid generic flat layouts. Maintain tactile ink borders (#172337), playful pastel surfaces, and smooth arcade responsiveness.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_overlays: Headers, floating menus, and modals MUST have solid/frosted non-transparent backgrounds (bg-white/90 or solid #fffaf5 with backdrop-blur).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Maintain generous padding inside cards and modals for comfortable mobile touch interactions.
